_comment: Grocery price quotes for the D-6 price source (grocery/prices.py, ADR-009). Each entry is a real, cited price for one ingredient key from nutrition/data/recipe_catalog.json; never estimate a price. The first nine are U.S. city average retail prices from the Bureau of Labor Statistics, September 2026 (one unit each: 1 lb, 1 dozen, 1 gal). The rest are Walmart.com shelf prices seen on 2026-11-03; each source names the product and its page, and the price can vary by store. green-onions has no entry: Walmart sells it by the bunch with no weight, which the catalog's per-onion weight cannot convert. To add or refresh a price, edit an entry with its source and the date you saw it.
